From: Liam Porter <liam.porter@archonhealth.com>

Cc: security@archonhealth.com
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Archon CAIQ intake + two exception items

Hi Kimberly and team,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. We ran the initial CAIQ scan and have three asks to make the submission actionable: an annotated CAIQ mapping tied to your control artifacts, a sample of runtime key rotation evidence (we're specifically looking for rotation events tied to an HSM/KMS), and a short exception log where you flag any controls that are met by compensating controls or in-flight remediation.

Can you confirm whether you can provide: 
- An annotated CAIQ workbook that maps each question to a Redwood control artifact (logs, runbooks, design docs)
- A rotation log or signed export showing a KMS/HSM key rotation event for the tenant-bound keystore
- A one-pager listing exceptions or temporary compensating controls and expected closure dates

Our audit window is mid-May; if we can get the annotated workbook + exception list by next Tuesday (Apr 6) and a rotation sample by Apr 13, that should keep us on schedule.

Appreciate it — I can loop in legal or procurement as needed.

Best,
Liam
Liam Porter
Head of Security Programs
Archon Health

Liam — thanks for the clear ask and timeline. We're on it. High-level plan:

1) Annotated CAIQ workbook: Marissa will produce an initial pass that links every CAIQ question to our control artifacts and where possible attach excerpts or links. Expect a first draft by EOD Apr 6.
2) Rotation evidence: our rotation records are held in the KMS audit stream. We can extract a redacted rotation event for tenant-bound keys. Jonas is going to validate the export and confirm whether HSM-level attestations exist for the timeframe you referenced. Target: Apr 13.
3) Exception log: we'll produce a concise exceptions register listing controls without direct artifacts + compensating controls and closure ETA. Draft by Apr 6.

If that schedule works I'll bundle the annotated workbook and exception register and share a Drive link; for rotation logs we may need a short JIRA ticket to capture redaction needs from your team (PII/PHI concerns).

Kimberly Park
Sr. Security & Compliance Manager

Liam / Archon security team — quick technical note on the rotation evidence:

I pulled the tenant keystore rotation events from our KMS audit and identified the rotation on 2027-03-29 at 02:11:43 UTC. The raw audit contains user identifiers and truncated key fingerprints. We can provide a sanitized export that includes timestamp, operation (rotate), key_id (hashed), and signer principal. Example row (sanitized):

2027-03-29T02:11:43Z, rotate, key_******, system:rotation-service

We cannot share raw HSM module internal logs externally for NDAs reasons, but we can provide an HSM attestation summary signed by our platform security team showing the rotation was performed in the HSM-backed KMS and listing the module firmware baseline and vendor attestation date.

I've attached a redaction-friendly log sample (keystore_rotation_log.txt) and queued a DocuSign invite for a mutual NDA so we can include slightly more telemetry if your legal team approves.

If Archon requires the raw HSM audit bundle we can run a formal exception request; expect a 5-7 business day review. Otherwise the sanitized export plus attestation summary should satisfy most control owners.

Jonas Weber
Staff Infrastructure Security Engineer
Redwood Inference
